meta.name: ai-community-marketing
meta.description: 社群运营策划助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“社群怎么活起来”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。

copy.tagline: 根据输入材料生成社群运营行动清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速制定社群活跃方案并落地执行。
copy.tagline_en: Generate actionable community marketing checklists from input materials.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create and execute community engagement plans.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，当你提出社群运营相关问题时，Claude 会分析你的目标、受众和材料，输出转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“社群怎么活起来”这类问题，或需要围绕社群运营生成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个社群的活跃度问题，给出优先级清单。
say.note: Claude 会输出转化问题优先级和行动清单。

say.text: 根据这份用户反馈，生成可复制的改稿方案。
say.note: Claude 会结合材料输出改稿建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes your goals, audience, and materials related to community operations, and outputs conversion issue priorities, replicable copy edits, experiments, or follow-up action lists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like "how to revive a community" or need actionable results for community operations.

say_en.text: Analyze this community's engagement issues and give a priority list.
say_en.note: Claude outputs conversion issue priorities and action list.

say_en.text: Generate replicable copy edits based on this user feedback.
say_en.note: Claude outputs copy edit suggestions using the material.
